messages.author: 37ffc8fdaa4a5001
messages.subject: Modified init.d script for Debian
parts:
Hello all,

For what it is worth I had to make a minor change to the Debian init.d script to get it to work (on Wheezy):

simply replace:

DAEMON=shiny-server

with

DAEMON=/usr/bin/shiny-server
